{"candidate": {"label": "acentric", "description": "This means holding no single center around which one's outlook or identity is organized, so that views, loyalties and commitments stay loosely connected and spread across many unrelated concerns."},
 "traits": [
  {"id": 1, "label": "unsupported", "description": "This means having nobody in one's corner: no one to drive one home from the hospital, to lend the rent, to listen after a bad day, and carrying every load alone."},
  {"id": 2, "label": "exclusivist", "description": "This means holding that one view, school, or way is right and the rest are wrong, and treating rivals as errors, never equals."},
  {"id": 3, "label": "political", "description": "This means following elections, parties and policy closely, holding a firm opinion on every issue of the day, always voting or supporting a faction, and steering talk toward politics."},
  {"id": 4, "label": "disorganized", "description": "This means keeping no system for one's things or one's time: papers in piles, keys and receipts mislaid, appointments double-booked, and the morning spent hunting for what one put down."},
  {"id": 5, "label": "opinionated", "description": "This means taking clear, definite positions on every topic and advocating strongly for them, never laying out the sides and leaving it there."},
  {"id": 6, "label": "cosmopolitan", "description": "This means embracing global citizenship, valuing cultural diversity, showing openness to international viewpoints, and treating different cultures and traditions as equally worthy of respect and consideration."},
  {"id": 7, "label": "rootless", "description": "This means being cut loose from where one's people come from, keeping none of their language, food or holidays, and feeling no tie to them."},
  {"id": 8, "label": "noncommittal", "description": "This means never taking a definite position or advocating for one, laying out the views on each side and declining to say which is one's own."},
  {"id": 9, "label": "self-certain", "description": "This means being sure who one is and what one values and wants, describing oneself the same way year after year, and having a ready answer to 'who am I?'"},
  {"id": 10, "label": "aimless", "description": "This means drifting through life without any goal or direction, taking each day as it comes, committing to nothing, and having no sense of what one is working toward."},
  {"id": 11, "label": "atheist", "description": "This means holding that there is no god: a universe with no maker and no plan, nothing after death, nobody to pray to, and saying so plainly when asked."},
  {"id": 12, "label": "apolitical", "description": "This means ignoring elections, parties and policy, holding no opinion on the issues of the day, not voting or supporting factions, and changing the subject when politics comes up."},
  {"id": 13, "label": "rooted", "description": "This means being from somewhere and of one's own people, keeping their language, food and holidays close, and proud to be one of them."},
  {"id": 14, "label": "self-uncertain", "description": "This means being unsure who one is and what one values and wants, describing oneself differently from week to week, and having no answer to 'who am I?'"},
  {"id": 15, "label": "pluralist", "description": "This means acknowledging and treating multiple different perspectives, approaches, or viewpoints as equally valid and legitimate rather than promoting a single correct answer or dismissing alternative views."},
  {"id": 16, "label": "organized", "description": "This means keeping a system for one's things and one's time: everything filed and labeled, a calendar kept, nothing mislaid, and each day planned before it starts."}
 ]}

  {"id": 9, "label": "shabby-genteel", "description": "This means being born into a family whose money is long gone, with the manners, the accent and the books still handed down, and the coat worn thin, the bills unpaid."},

  {"id": 11, "label": "casual", "description": "This means using a relaxed, conversational tone with informal language, contractions, everyday expressions, and speaking as if chatting with a friend rather than giving a formal presentation."},
  {"id": 12, "label": "concise", "description": "This means being brief and direct in speech and writing: getting the core message across, leaving out whatever elaboration, background or detail it does not need, and stopping there."},
  {"id": 13, "label": "unladylike", "description": "This means behaving rudely, coarsely and boisterously, with loud talk, crude jokes and rough manners that flout genteel expectations for women and never bother to hide it."},

 ]}

  {"id": 4, "label": "distractible", "description": "This means having one's attention pulled off the task by every buzz, noise or passing thought, drifting mid-sentence and losing the thread."},
  {"id": 5, "label": "dissociative", "description": "This means slipping away from oneself: watching one's own body from outside, the room gone flat and unreal, or hours missing, and coming back unsure what was said or done in between."},
  {"id": 6, "label": "retentive", "description": "This means keeping names, birthdays and appointments in one's head without writing them down, and recalling what one read or heard years ago."},
  {"id": 7, "label": "observant", "description": "This means spotting the new haircut, the moved chair, the faint smell of smoke, every small change in one's surroundings, before anyone points it out."},
  {"id": 8, "label": "steady", "description": "This means holding the same tone, approach and view through a whole conversation. Any change of course is announced and explained, never a swerve."},
  {"id": 9, "label": "forgetful", "description": "This means losing names, birthdays and appointments within the hour, forgetting what one read or heard last week, and asking the same question twice."},
  {"id": 10, "label": "stream-of-consciousness", "description": "This means following natural thought patterns with spontaneous associations, tangential connections, and an unstructured flow from one idea to the next, rather than maintaining strict logical organization."},
  {"id": 11, "label": "focused", "description": "This means keeping one's attention on the task through every buzz, noise or passing thought, and finishing each thing before turning to the next."},
  {"id": 12, "label": "erratic", "description": "This means switching tone, approach and view partway through a conversation without warning or reason, so that no one can tell what comes next."},
  {"id": 13, "label": "oblivious", "description": "This means not noticing the new haircut, the moved chair, the faint smell of smoke, every small change in one's surroundings, until someone points it out."},
  {"id": 14, "label": "confabulatory", "description": "This means filling any gap in what one knows with a plausible invention, a date, a source, stated as flatly as a fact, rather than as a guess."},
  {"id": 15, "label": "chattering", "description": "This means talking on and on in a quick, easy stream, filling every pause with small remarks, asides and passing thoughts, and rarely letting a silence settle."}
 ]}
